---
title: "Mapping Districts of Texas and Maryland"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: openintro::lab_report
---

```{r load-packages, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(openintro)
library(alarmdata)
library(redist)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggredist)
library(sf)
```

### Texas

Link to SHP file for 2025 approved redistricting map: https://redistrictingdatahub.org/dataset/2025-texas-congressional-districts-approved-plan/

```{r}
map_texas <- alarm_50state_map('TX')
#plans_texas <- alarm_50state_plans('TX')

# precinct map
map_texas |> 
    ggplot() +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = ndv / (nrv + ndv)), color = NA) +
    scale_fill_party_c() +
    theme_map()

# 2020 district map
map_texas |> 
    ggplot() +
    geom_district(aes(group = cd_2020, fill = ndv, denom = nrv + ndv)) +
    scale_fill_party_c() +
    theme_map()

# Districts colored by vote share with dashed precinct borders overlaid
map_texas |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_district(aes(group=cd_2020,fill=ndv, denom=ndv+nrv), linewidth=0.6) +
  geom_sf(linewidth=0.2, linetype="dashed", fill=NA) +
  scale_fill_party_b(limits=c(0.4, 0.6)) +
  theme_map()

# Precincts colored by vote share with district borders overlaid
map_texas |>
    ggplot() +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = ndv / (nrv + ndv)), color = NA) +
    geom_district(aes(group=cd_2020), linewidth=0.6, fill = NA) +
    scale_fill_party_c() +
    theme_map()

# Dashed county lines under solid district lines
map_texas |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_district(aes(group=cd_2020,fill=ndv, denom=ndv+nrv), linewidth=0.6) +
  geom_district(aes(group=county), linewidth=0.2, linetype="dashed", fill=NA) +
  scale_fill_party_b(limits=c(0.4, 0.6)) +
  theme_map()
```

### Zoomed-in TX maps

```{r}
# Text overlay for major cities
map_texas |>
    ggplot() +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = ndv / (nrv + ndv)), color = NA) +
    annotate(geom = "text", x = -95.3701, y = 29.7601, label = "Houston") +
    annotate(geom = "text", x = -98.49, y = 29.42, label = "San Antonio") +
    annotate(geom = "text", x = -96.80, y = 32.78, label = "Dallas") +
    annotate(geom = "text", x = -97.74, y = 30.26, label = "Austin") +
    annotate(geom = "text", x = -106.42, y = 31.77, label = "El Paso") +
    coord_sf(xlim = c(-108, -93), ylim = c(25, 37), expand = FALSE, default_crs = sf::st_crs(4326)) +
    scale_fill_party_c() +
    theme_map() #theme_map()
```

### TX demographics

``` {r}
# black*
map_texas |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = vap_black / vap), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c("Black VAP %", option = "plasma") +
  theme_map()

# hisp**
map_texas |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = vap_hisp / vap), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c("Hispanic\nVAP %", option = "plasma") +
  theme_map()

# asian
map_texas |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = vap_asian / vap), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c("Asian VAP %", option = "plasma") +
  theme_map()

#total minority
map_texas <- map_texas |>
  mutate(vap_minor = (vap_hisp + vap_black + vap_aian + vap_asian + vap_nhpi + vap_other))
map_texas |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = vap_minor / vap), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c("Minority\nVAP %", option = "plasma") +
  theme_map()

race_palette <- c(
  "Hispanic" = "#e67e22",
  "White"    = "#3498db",
  "Black"    = "#2ecc71",
  "AIAN"     = "#e74c3c",
  "Asian"    = "#9b59b6",
  "NHPI"     = "#f1c40f",
  "Other"    = "#95a5a6",
  "Two+"     = "#d35400"
)

map_texas <- map_texas |> 
  mutate(majority_race = case_when(
    vap_hisp  == pmax(vap_hisp, vap_white, vap_black, vap_aian, 
                      vap_asian, vap_nhpi, vap_other, vap_two) ~ "Hispanic",
    vap_white == pmax(vap_hisp, vap_white, vap_black, vap_aian, 
                      vap_asian, vap_nhpi, vap_other, vap_two) ~ "White",
    vap_black == pmax(vap_hisp, vap_white, vap_black, vap_aian, 
                      vap_asian, vap_nhpi, vap_other, vap_two) ~ "Black",
    vap_aian  == pmax(vap_hisp, vap_white, vap_black, vap_aian, 
                      vap_asian, vap_nhpi, vap_other, vap_two) ~ "AIAN",
    vap_asian == pmax(vap_hisp, vap_white, vap_black, vap_aian, 
                      vap_asian, vap_nhpi, vap_other, vap_two) ~ "Asian",
    vap_nhpi  == pmax(vap_hisp, vap_white, vap_black, vap_aian, 
                      vap_asian, vap_nhpi, vap_other, vap_two) ~ "NHPI",
    vap_other == pmax(vap_hisp, vap_white, vap_black, vap_aian, 
                      vap_asian, vap_nhpi, vap_other, vap_two) ~ "Other",
    vap_two   == pmax(vap_hisp, vap_white, vap_black, vap_aian, 
                      vap_asian, vap_nhpi, vap_other, vap_two) ~ "Two+",
    TRUE ~ "Multiple/Tie"
  ))

# Map all races in TX by majority in each precinct
map_texas |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = majority_race), color = NA) + #size = 0.01
  geom_district(aes(group=cd_2020), color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth=0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = race_palette) +
  theme_map() +
  labs(fill = "Majority Race (VAP)")

```
